useIndex.description:
If True, then the indices of `targetOutput`, `modelOutput`, and `context` are used for score
calculation.

batchSize.description:
If the provided data does not fit in memory, then use this value as batch size to iterate through and compute incremental
metrics on batches of data.

probaThreshold.description:
`probaThreshold` is a `double` value used to convert the predicted probabilities to class
labels for F-beta Score calculation. `probaThreshold` defaults to 0.5 if no value is provided with the predicted
probabilities as input

title:
The {@link MlFbetaScoreMetric} computes the weighted harmonic mean of precision and recall,
where an F-beta score reaches its best value at 1 and worst score at 0. The formula for the F-beta score is:
```
F-beta =  (1 + beta^2) * precision * recall / (beta^2 * precision + recall)
```
This metric only works for binary classification. If there are no true positive and false positive predictions,
this metric returns 0. The `modelOutput` can either be a single-dimensional with binary (i.e. 0 and 1) data or
two-dimensional with predicted probabilities for class '0' and '1'.  Column '1' will be used for scoring.
The `targetOutput` is expected to be single-dimensional with binary (i.e. 0 and 1) data. This metric supports
`sampleWeights`  as `context`. `sampleWeights` is single-dimensional with same number of samples as the
`modelOutput`. It represents a per-sample weighting when aggregating for F-beta Score calculation.
name: MlFbetaScoreMetric
